<!-- pr-reviewer: 48af1034008a31666afc1646dc2bdb6e40f174e6 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Direction is right. The chuck solid is the steel, so a bore must be at or inside the true circle. `ring` now draws the bore with vertices on the bore circle (`r_in` as is), so the flats sit inside it by r(1-cos(pi/64)) and the drawn steel can only be extra, never missing. Outer faces stay circumscribed (`flats_on(r_out)`), so they are at or outside the true radius at flat midpoints and further out at the vertices.
- Coverage of inner surfaces: `ring` is the only round-bore path (3/4-jaw through bore, collet nose and body bores, all four call sites in chuck.rs). Jaws are boxes and are unchanged.
- The app volume expectation moved to MORE steel: inscribed area n*sin*cos*ri^2 is below the old flats-on area n*tan*ri^2, so the subtracted bore shrinks. The new `ring_area` formula matches the inscribed-polygon area.
- The tightened tests probe 1e-3 mm inside outer faces and outside bore walls at all 128 vertex and flat-middle angles (nudged 1e-7 off the seam), plus air past each allowance. I put the old line back in the sim `ring` (`flats_on(r_in)`): both `three_jaw_envelope_is_pinned` and `collet_envelope_is_pinned` fail with "steel just outside the bore wall at 0.0000001 rad". They pass on the PR head.
- Decision file records the safe direction, the accepted cost (extra steel up to 0.12 % of the bore radius; the clash warning counts only past 0.05 mm) and what was dropped.

**Results (locally, merged with main, own worktree; the Linux runner was busy and the macOS one does not count, so no runner run)**
- `camcraft-sim --test lathe_chuck`: 6 passed
- `camcraft-app --test builtin_accessory`: 3 passed; also `lathe_chuck` 3, `lathe_workholding_live` 3, `lathe_workholding_kinds` 10 (1 ignored), `mcp_accessory` 2, `lathe_workholding_rpm` 6: all passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

**Requested before merge:** none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Not run: the rest of the app suites that use chuck fixtures, and any Windows-only reading (none is touched).
- Body text and commit subjects were not checked beyond the diff.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
